theme: glider fleet milking drifting thermals that crowds kill
title: Thermal Timetable: Milking Drifting Lift Without Crowding
strategies: straight-line baseline: every glider dashes for the beacon nearest its own launch point, thermals ignored entirely

obvious greedy: every glider independently chases the single richest thermal (highest lift constant), circles it, then homes on the best-looking beacon; no coordination, so it crowds the rich thermal in the trap cases

flow-over-time insight: rank (thermal, arrival time-bucket) slots by MARGINAL lift given who has already reserved that slot, so the fleet time-shares rich thermals and disperses onto weak-but-uncrowded thermals, and gliders claim distinct beacons instead of piling onto the same one
